object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Weak for MELLON-MCP-SRS-81. No test leaves another file changed or staged to show that it stays out of the commit, and none checks that the commit's message is the given commit_message (only that the trailer is there). For MELLON-MCP-SRS-87, short_hash isn't compared with the new latest commit.
object.description: In a copy of the req-test repository, make each of these calls with a commit_message: set_attribute; bulk_set_attribute on three objects; and the eight multi-file writes (create_document, delete_attribute, remove_attr_option, new_object with a link, copy_object, remove_link that deletes the links file, delete_object with force, manage_view rename). Expected: each call makes a new commit and git reports no uncommitted change afterwards. The result's commit holds a short_hash that names a commit carrying the Via: mellon-mcp trailer, and a commit_message.
